List<int> maximum(List<int> arr, int k) {
  if (k == 0 || k >= arr.length) return List.from(arr);
  
  final n = arr.length;
  final result = <int>[];
  var i = 0;
  while (i < n && k > 0) {
    // Find the max in subarray from i to min(i + k, n - 1)
    var maxIndex = i;
    for (var j = i; j <= min(i + k, n - 1); j++) {
      if (arr[j] > arr[maxIndex]) {
        maxIndex = j;
      }
    }
    result.add(arr[maxIndex]);
    // Skip elements that are not part of the next window
    i += k;
    k -= (maxIndex - i + 1);
  }
  // Add remaining elements
  while (i < n) {
    result.add(arr[i++]);
  }
  return result;
}

List<List<int>> generatePermutations(List<int> list) {
  if (list.isEmpty) return [[]];
  
  List<List<int>> result = [];
  for (int i = 0; i < list.length; i++) {
    List<int> remaining = List.from(list)..removeAt(i);
    List<List<int>> subPerms = generatePermutations(remaining);
    
    for (var perm in subPerms) {
      List<int> newPerm = [list[i]]..addAll(perm);
      result.add(newPerm);
    }
  }
  
  return result;
}

bool isEqualToSumEven(int n) {
  if (n < 2) return false;
  
  int sum = 0;
  for (int i = 1; i <= sqrt(n); ++i) {
    if (n % i == 0) {
      if (i.isEven) sum += i;
      if ((n ~/ i).isEven && i != (n ~/ i)) {
        sum += n ~/ i;
      }
    }
  }

  return sum == n;
}
